hero.title: Winter Courses in Finland
hero.subtitle: Experience world-class academic training and global career pathways in Finland with Edu-Hawk Worldwide.

overview: **Winter Courses in Finland** may cover subjects such as business, technology, design, ecology, sports sciences, and Finnish language and culture. For example, **Aalto University’s Winter School 2027** is scheduled for **18–29 January 2027**, with courses connected to technology, design, and business. Applications are listed as open from **15 September to 15 November 2026**, so interested students should check the official course pages for current requirements and available places.

faq.question: What are Winter Courses in Finland?
faq.answer: Winter courses are intensive 1 to 2-week academic programmes hosted during January and February by leading Finnish universities (like Aalto and Jyväskylä), granting 2 to 6 transferable ECTS credits in technology, design, sports science, and ecology.

faq.question: Can international and Indian students apply for Finnish winter schools?
faq.answer: Yes. International college students, graduates, and professionals can apply directly for English-taught winter courses across Finland.

faq.question: How much do Winter Courses in Finland cost?
faq.answer: Tuition generally ranges between €600 and €1,200 for 1 to 2-week courses (approx ₹65,000 to ₹1.3 lakh). Accommodation and living expenses average €250 to €450 per week.

faq.question: Do winter courses in Finland grant transferable ECTS credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Accredited Finnish winter schools provide an official University Transcript of Records awarding 2 to 6 ECTS credits compliant with European standards.

faq.question: When should I apply for Winter Courses in Finland?
faq.answer: Application deadlines vary by university. For example, Aalto University lists its Winter School 2027 application period from 15 September to 15 November 2026 for courses scheduled from 18–29 January 2027. Always check current dates on official course pages before applying.
